stories.title: Finance minister nominee says corporate tax cut not under consideration

en.title: Finance minister nominee says corporate tax cut not under consideration
en.summary: South Korea's finance minister nominee Lee Hyoung-il stated that a corporate tax cut is not being considered, noting that the corporate tax rate was recently restored this year.

stories.title: Lee Chang-dong's Venice win shines light on Korean cinema's understated auteur

en.title: Lee Chang-dong's Venice win shines light on Korean cinema's understated auteur
en.summary: Director Lee Chang-dong's film "Possible Love" won the Silver Lion Grand Jury Prize at the Venice Film Festival, marking his first feature film in eight years and featuring four major Korean actors.

en.title: (2nd LD) Gender minister nominee withdraws from consideration amid mounting controversy
en.summary: President Lee Jae Myung's nominee for gender equality minister has withdrawn from consideration following escalating controversy surrounding the appointment.

stories.title: Presidential Office Respects Gender Equality Minister Nominee's Withdrawal

en.title: Presidential Office Respects Gender Equality Minister Nominee's Withdrawal
en.summary: The presidential office announced it respects Rep. Yong Hye-in's withdrawal as gender equality and family minister nominee, stating future appointments will meet public expectations.

stories.title: Gender Equality Minister Nominee Withdraws from Consideration amid Controversy

en.title: Gender Equality Minister Nominee Withdraws from Consideration amid Controversy
en.summary: Yong Hye-in, President Lee Jae Myung's nominee for gender equality minister, withdrew from consideration after 14 days, citing regret at being unable to continue. Yong is the sole lawmaker of the minor Basic Income Party.

stories.title: Gender minister nominee steps aside amid mounting pressure

en.title: Gender minister nominee steps aside amid mounting pressure
en.summary: Gender Equality and Family Minister nominee Yong Hye-in withdrew from consideration as opposition grew within the ruling party. The sole lawmaker of the minor Basic Income Party announced her decision two weeks after nomination, just before confirmation hearings.

stories.title: Lee Chang-dong Wins Venice Jury Grand Prize for 'Possible Love'

en.title: Lee Chang-dong Wins Venice Jury Grand Prize for 'Possible Love'
en.summary: Director Lee Chang-dong received the Silver Lion Grand Jury Prize at the Venice International Film Festival for his film "Possible Love," which features actors Jeon Do-yeon, Sol Kyung-gu, Zo In-sung, and Cho Yeo-jeong.

stories.title: Pres. Office Says Gender Minister Nominee Should Get Chance to Address Allegations

en.title: Pres. Office Says Gender Minister Nominee Should Get Chance to Address Allegations
en.summary: The presidential office stated that Gender Equality Minister nominee Yong Hye-in deserves an opportunity to address allegations against her during parliamentary confirmation hearings. The position was relayed by Chief presidential spokesperson Kang Yu-jung.
